mapper.select: SELECT print_job_id, status_cd, actor_user_cd, object_type, object_id, file_no, request_no, count_applied_yn FROM docs_print_job WHERE print_job_id = #{value} FOR UPDATE
SELECT print_job_id, item_seq, object_type, object_id, file_no, request_no, request_type, count_required_yn FROM docs_print_job_item WHERE print_job_id = #{value} ORDER BY item_seq
mapper.update: UPDATE docs_print_job SET status_cd = #{result.statusCd}, page_count = #{result.pageCount}, copy_count = #{result.copyCount}, printer_nm = #{result.printerNm}, device_id = #{result.deviceId}, error_message = #{result.errorMessage}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE print_job_id = #{result.printJobId} AND actor_user_cd = #{actorUserCd} AND status_cd = 'STARTED'
